dedupe_keys.name: loureiro energy cooperative electricity consumption of 172 buildings

description: This dataset contains electricity-consumption measurements from 172 buildings belonging to a local energy cooperative in Loureiro, Portugal. The research collaborators assemble smart-meter readings and weather observations from the nearest station in Aveiro to support community-energy analysis. The repository describes 46,608 quarter-hour rows covering 5 May 2022–2 September 2023, with a column for each building and additional weather fields. Mendeley supplies the documented CSV within a ZIP archive, free under CC BY 4.0. Some building measurements are missing and explicitly marked as NaN. Coverage is a geographically concentrated cooperative, and station weather does not measure conditions at each building. These limitations matter when deriving coincident peaks or household archetypes. A reviewer-assessed use is testing local energy-sharing rules or cooperative demand-management scenarios. model-pypsa is a related electricity optimization environment, without an established import mapping. No archive was downloaded and no metering interval or timestamp alignment was independently checked.
